meta.name: Student Lifecycle
meta.description: Full lifecycle: admin pre-creates a student via API, creates a waiting-list entry by searching the combobox, verifies the entry, verifies the student appears in the roster, and views the student profile.
meta.author: claude-ai

workflows.name: Login as Admin
workflows.description: Sign in with the admin account and land on the dashboard.

steps.description: Sign in with admin credentials
Verify we are on the dashboard
Capture dashboard state
steps.name: 01-dashboard

workflows.name: Create Waiting-List Entry
workflows.description: Pre-creates the student via API (so they appear in the client-profiles list on page load), then opens the waiting list, clicks 'רשומה חדשה', searches for the student in the combobox, selects a service, and saves the entry.

steps.description: Create the student via POST /api/students-list so they are in clientProfiles when the page loads
Go to the waiting list page (fresh load ensures client-profiles includes the new student)
Wait for waiting list page to load
Capture waiting list before adding entry
steps.name: 02-waiting-list

steps.description: Click the 'רשומה חדשה' button to open the create dialog
Wait for the new-entry dialog to open
Click the student combobox to focus it and open the dropdown
Type the student first name to filter the combobox options
Wait for the matching student option to appear in the dropdown
Click the student option to select them — this calls commitOption → handleStudentChange with a valid clientProfileId
Capture the form after student is selected
steps.name: 03-student-selected

steps.description: Open the service selector dropdown
Wait for service options to appear
Click the first available service option
Capture the entry form with student and service filled
steps.name: 04-entry-with-service

steps.description: Submit the waiting-list entry with 'שמירה'
Wait for the dialog to close after successful save
Capture waiting list after entry was created
steps.name: 05-entry-created

workflows.name: Verify Entry Appears in Waiting List
workflows.description: Navigate to the waiting list and confirm the new entry card is visible.

steps.description: Return to the waiting list
Confirm the new student's entry card is visible in the queue
Capture the waiting list showing the new entry
steps.name: 06-entry-in-waiting-list

workflows.name: Verify Student Appears in Roster
workflows.description: Navigate to the students list and confirm the newly created student is visible.

steps.description: Go to the students list page
Wait for the students table to load
Confirm the student row is visible in the table
Capture the students list showing the new student
steps.name: 07-student-in-roster

workflows.name: View Student Profile
workflows.description: Click into the student's profile from the roster and verify the profile page loads.

steps.description: Ensure we are on the students list
Click the student's name link to open the profile
Wait for the profile URL to contain /students/
Confirm student name appears in the page heading
Capture the student profile page
steps.name: 08-student-profile
